distance_from_cbd: 27 km (17 mi) south-east of Melbourne CBD
housing_building_stock_character: Large master-planned family suburb of 1980s-90s residential estates (Rowville Lakes, Park Ridge, Timbertop, etc.) plus light-industrial premises; predominantly detached homes on estate subdivisions, one of the largest south-east suburbs.
source_quotes: Rowville recorded a population of 33,571 at the 2021 census.
Rowville developed rapidly throughout the 1980s and 1990s, with housing and light industrial premises being built.
These were the Rowville Lakes estate (by Hooker-Rex) and the adjoining Park Ridge estate (by Stocks & Holdings), which together provided 2500 allotments.
Rowville is one of the largest suburbs south-east of Melbourne.
